guide: **Primary — Hang Zhou Xiao Long Bao (Hangzhou South Road Section 2)**
- Estimated 10–15 min walking from Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall complex; casual indoor / air-conditioned Taiwanese dumpling restaurant.
- **Budget for two:** NT$400–650 (₱787–₱1,279 approximately).
- **Estimated queue:** light 10–20 min; normal 30–45 min; busy Saturday lunch 45–75+ min.
- **Queue decision:** <15 min → stay; 15–30 min → stay if comfortable; >30 min → consider switching to Chun Shui Tang.
- **Ordering steps:**
1. Go to restaurant entrance.
2. Look for queue-number tablet and register 2 people if still in use.
3. Wait until number is called.
4. If staff instruct, scan table QR to order.
5. Select dishes and submit.
6. Check whether drinks / sides are self-service.
7. Pay at cashier as instructed; bring cash.
- **Historical menu price references (not verified as current):** soup dumplings NT$190 (₱374), hot-and-sour soup NT$80 (₱157), side dish NT$60 (₱118).
- **Lower-fat considerations:** check steamed vegetable or shrimp-based dumplings; ask about fillings and soup fat; do not assume pork soup dumplings are low-fat.
**Backup — Chun Shui Tang (CKS Memorial Hall branch)**
- **Location:** National Concert Hall, Gate 2. Indoor, air-conditioned Taiwanese tea-house style.
- **Published reference opening time:** 11:30 AM; verify current Saturday schedule.
- **Queue allowance:** 10–30+ minutes (can be longer).
- **Budget for two:** NT$500–800 (₱984–₱1,574 approximately).
- **Ordering steps:**
1. Find the National Concert Hall Gate 2 entrance.
2. Request table for two.
3. Take queue number if necessary.
4. Use QR menu or follow current staff ordering system.
5. Choose lighter available options such as soups, vegetables, noodles, unsweetened tea.
6. Confirm and pay following staff directions.
- **Lower-fat considerations:** look for chicken / mushroom soups, lower-oil noodles or vegetables; avoid heavily sauced or fried food if triggering symptoms.

blocks.text: **Area:** Kunming Street, Ximending.
**Planning budget:** NT$240–420 for 2 (≈ ₱472–827; ₱236–413/person).
From **Airline Inn Taipei Ximen**, navigate to 艋舺人清粥小菜 near Kunming Street; allow walking time.
**Priority order: 清蒸鮮魚 — Steamed Fresh Fish**, menu photo reference **NT$190**.
**Other orders are allowed:** congee, rice, vegetables and other breakfast dishes depending on appetite. This is **not** a fixed set menu.
Ask for **少油 (shǎo yóu)** = less oil, if needed. Finish around 8:10 AM.
**Diet note:** Steamed and lower-fat dishes may be easier to tolerate with gallstones, but individual triggers vary; avoid heavily oily accompaniments.
**Backup:** Check restaurant opening hours before travel; if unavailable choose a quick nearby light breakfast.
**Cost:** Free.
Walk to **Ximen MRT Exit 6** near Hanzhong Street.
Find the famous Rainbow Six painted street.
Take full-body OOTD photos, couple photos, wide-angle city shots and a short walking video.
Keep the pedestrian route clear and walk toward The Red House.
**Cost:** Free exterior photos.
Walk to The Red House at **No. 10 Chengdu Road**.
Photograph the octagonal red-brick façade, entrance, windows and symmetrical angles.
Continue to nearby Taipei Tianhou Temple.
**Reminder:** On Sunday morning, the focus is outside because indoor shops typically open later.
**Cost:** Generally free.
Walk to **No. 51 Chengdu Road**.
Explore the ornate entryway, colorful roof carvings, lanterns and traditional temple architecture.
Take respectful exterior/courtyard pictures where photography is permitted.
Continue toward Nishi Honganji Square.
**Reminder:** Respect worshippers and any no-photography signs.

blocks.text: **Cost:** Free outdoor visit.

Take architecture, couple and greenery photos.
Enjoy a relaxed short walk before returning to the pedestrian area.
**Backup:** Cut this to 10–15 minutes if delayed.
**Cost:** Free; shopping optional and excluded from budget.
Stroll around **Hanzhong Street, Wuchang Street** and nearby pedestrian blocks.
Photograph colorful signs, shops, streetscapes and OOTDs.
Note that many shops may still be closed this early.
Head back toward Airline Inn by 10:05 AM.

Take EasyCard, phone with Taiwan eSIM, water, umbrella/rain protection, light snacks and a power bank.

**海鮮粥 — Seafood Congee:** online reference **NT$225/bowl**.
**海鮮米粉 — Seafood Rice Vermicelli Soup:** online reference **NT$220/bowl**.
Enter the Ximen branch and check the actual menu.
Choose either of the dishes above; both diners may order the same or different bowls.
Ask for less oil and avoid deep-fried toppings if preferred.
Pay and **leave by ~11:35 AM** to reach Shilin in time.
**Note:** Prices above are previous online menu references; dine-in prices may differ. **35 minutes is a tight meal window**, especially if there is a queue.
**Backup:** Use a quicker nearby meal if the wait is too long, or accept a later S15 rather than rushing unsafely.
**Planning fare:** NT$60–80 for 2 (≈ ₱118–157).
Walk to **Ximen MRT Station G12 / BL11**.
Take the **Green Line (Songshan–Xindian)** toward **Songshan**.
Get off at **Zhongshan Station G14**, passing Beimen.

Get off at **Shilin Station R16**.

**Planning time:** 30–40 minutes including walking and transfer.

activities.title: Find S15 stop; prepare to board
activities.location: 捷運士林站(中正) — MRT Shilin Station (Zhongzheng).

blocks.text: **Stop:** **捷運士林站(中正) — MRT Shilin Station (Zhongzheng)**.
**Cost:** Free to wait.
Find the stop for **小15 (S15) toward 擎天崗 (Qingtiangang)**.
Check bus signage and the official live tracker.
Queue on the correct side of Zhongzheng Road; have EasyCard ready.
Aim to be at the stop by 12:15–12:20 PM.
**Crucial:** Some S15 trips are short-turn services. Board only a bus displaying the **full Qingtiangang destination**.
**Uphill tracker:** [Open reference](https://ebus.gov.taipei/EBus/VsSimpleMap?gb=0&routeid=0151001500)
**Preferred transport:** 小15 (S15), regular public mountain bus.
**Planning time:** ~50–65 minutes.
**Planning fare:** NT$15/person; NT$30 for 2 (≈ ₱59 total). Verify current fare.
Verify destination display says **擎天崗**.
Board S15 and follow EasyCard tap instructions.
Sit when possible; winding mountain roads and Sunday crowds can make the ride uncomfortable if standing.
Follow progress on maps and alight at **Qingtiangang 擎天崗**.
**Before exploring, immediately check the downhill return-bus options.**
**Bus comfort:** Ordinary functional public bus / smaller city bus, **not premium tourist coach**; air-conditioning or seat availability cannot be guaranteed for a specific trip.

**If the 12:33 bus is missed:** Check later full-route S15 services, alternative connections (R5 + 108), or a real Uber quote. **Uber from Shilin to Qingtiangang** was budgeted at roughly **NT$400–650 per car**, an estimate not a live quote.
**Uphill tracker:** [Open reference](https://ebus.gov.taipei/EBus/VsSimpleMap?gb=0&routeid=0151001500)
**Admission:** Free.
**Priority:** Main nature destination of the day.
**Suggested activities:**
Visit the nearby visitor information/restroom facilities first.
Take wide-angle photos of the rolling green hills and panoramic mountain scenery.
Walk on **designated trails and fenced visitor paths**, stopping at viewpoints.
Look for water buffalo from a **safe distance**; never approach, feed or touch them.
Look for seasonal silvergrass, weather and conditions permitting.
Relax and enjoy nature, not necessarily the full ~2.4 km circular trail.
Start moving back to the bus stop by **3:40–3:45 PM**.

**What to wear:** Comfortable sneakers/trail-capable walking shoes with traction, relaxed trousers, T-shirt plus lightweight windbreaker; keep an umbrella/rain layer handy. It may be colder, foggier and windier than central Taipei.

**Important tradeoff:** Previously discussed a ~3-hour stay, but the **12:33 uphill and ~4 PM return targets** make this approximately **2–2.5 hours**, depending on arrival and the real downhill bus. For a full 3 hours, the return must move later and be checked against actual downhill service and daylight.
**Rules:** This is a protected grassland rather than a free-roam field like a general city park. Stay on allowed paths; watch for closures and buffalo restrictions.
**IMPORTANT: NOT a confirmed 4:00 PM S15 departure.**
Arrive at the Qingtiangang stop around **3:45 PM**.
Check **downhill S15 (小15) toward Jiantan / Shilin** on the tracker.
Take the next suitable confirmed bus; verify its stops, especially if getting off near Shilin Night Market.
If there is no useful S15, consider **Bus 108** toward Yangmingshan Bus Terminal, then **R5 (紅5)** toward Shilin/Jiantan, subject to operating hours and actual connections.
Taxi/Uber may be a fallback **if a driver accepts**, but mountain pickup availability can be limited.
**Downhill fare allowance:** NT$30–50 total for 2, depending on route/transfer.
**Downhill tracker:** [Open reference](https://ebus.gov.taipei/EBus/VsSimpleMap?gb=1&routeid=0151001500)
**Safety rule:** Verify the last practical transport down **before hiking**. If the return service is delayed, shorten or skip the Shilin evening activities.

activities.title: Arrive in Shilin; walk to night market

blocks.text: **Cost:** Free walking.
Get off near Shilin or Jiantan, depending on the actual bus service.
Follow Google Maps toward **Shilin Night Market / Danan Road**.
Enter the area from the Shilin side and gradually work toward **Jiantan Station** for your return trip.
**Note:** 5 PM is an estimate, not a promised arrival.
**Location:** No. 84 Danan Road, Shilin.
**Admission:** Free.
See the ornate Mazu temple roof, entrance, red lanterns and carvings.
Take photos where allowed and avoid disturbing worshippers.
Walk into the adjacent night-market streets.
**Skip if:** Late from Qingtiangang, tired, or would rather spend time at the night market.
**Planning allowance:** NT$450–900 for 2 (≈ ₱886–1,771), excluding optional shopping. Flexible snacks may replace a sit-down dinner.
**Activities:**
Food crawl: grilled mushrooms, fish-ball soup, grilled squid, aiyu jelly, drinks and other interesting snacks.
Browse clothes, sneakers, accessories and souvenirs along Danan/Dadong/Jihe Road areas.
Optional carnival games like ring toss and balloon popping; ask prices first.
Optional seated break at the Shilin Market food court.
Begin heading to Jiantan MRT around **8:45–9 PM**.
**Gallstone note:** Choose lower-oil preparations, smaller portions and foods personally tolerated; avoid making heavily deep-fried snacks the main meal.
**Backup:** If you reach Shilin late, just enjoy a short food crawl and skip temple, games and extended shopping.

days.notice: S15 12:33 PM uphill and ~4:00 PM return are planning targets, not confirmed departures. Check the return buses before exploring. Qingtiangang takes priority over optional Shilin stops.

blocks.text: **Replace:** S15 uphill, Qingtiangang and Qingtiangang downhill.
**Do not treat Beitou as an extra stop on the mountain-day version.**

**Suggested attractions:** Beitou Park, Beitou Hot Spring Museum, Thermal Valley (viewing only), hot-spring neighborhood sightseeing. Indoor and operating hours need verification on November 8; paid hot-spring bathing is optional and **not included**.
**Transport:**
Ximen MRT **G12** → Green Line toward Songshan → **Zhongshan G14**.
Transfer to Red Line toward **Beitou**.

Alight at **Xinbeitou** and follow signs toward Beitou Park / Thermal Valley.

**Weather:** [Open reference](https://www.cwa.gov.tw/eng/)

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Along the northern coast
days.subtitle: Tiaoshi → Yehliu → Shifen → Jiufen → Guilin

blocks.text: **Goal:** Eat a light breakfast and be ready for a full-day outdoor tour.
Check the weather, shower, dress comfortably and wear good walking shoes.
Have breakfast near the hotel; breakfast venue not selected.
